name: lr-transfer-pricing
description: Builds a Liberia transfer-pricing working paper for 2026 related-party transactions using Revenue Code sections 208 and 211, the 2016 Regulations and relevant official practice guidance. Use for Liberia arm’s length pricing, a related-party service charge, intercompany loan, master file, local file, comparable range or annual transfer-pricing return. The Guide covers practical control, domestic and permanent-establishment dealings, method selection, risk allocation, service benefits, contemporary documentation and amended recharacterisation powers. It distinguishes documentation relief for small taxpayers from substantive pricing relief. Literal inconsistencies in range and allocation wording, current return fields and operational country-by-country rules are explicit gaps; no accountant attestation or complete pack coverage is claimed.
